brief.title: Plan a 30-Day Tomato Time-Lapse Video: Set Up the Shoot and Shape the Video Ideas
brief.description: Plan a time-lapse video of tomatoes growing over 30 days, filmed on my phone from a tripod, with music. Outcome: a one-page shoot plan and three video ideas.
brief.status: Waiting for the start date and the camera position.
context: I would like to make a time-lapse video of tomatoes growing in my garden over 30 days. My phone will sit on a tripod so that every frame is taken from the same position.
I want the finished video to have music. The track is Not supplied.
This could be one video or the start of something more (to confirm).
actions: Next action: Choose the tripod position and take one test photo.
Decide the start date. No dates have been supplied yet.
Say what kind of music I have in mind.
Use the supplied information to prepare a one-page shoot plan and three video ideas.

plan.output: A one-page shoot plan and three video ideas.
steps: Draft the shoot plan from what is known and mark every gap.
Write three video ideas, each with a title and an opening line.
When I supply the start date and the camera position, add them to the shoot plan.
plan.tools: Word for the shoot plan; one writing agent for the video ideas.
plan.rhythm: One-off, then a weekly check while the shoot runs.
plan.done_when: The shoot plan and the three video ideas are saved, and the plan lists what still waits on me.
